summary: No held thesis broke on news today. The tape for held names was quiet: none of the 14 positions has a filing in the 7-day window (no 4.01, 4.02, 5.02 or 1.01/2.01), and the only company-specific items were supportive sell-side moves (Baird raised its WMT PT to $140 from $120 today, the sixth WMT PT raise since 11-09; Goldman raised its KR PT to $77 from $71 on 11-10). The macro thread from the 11-10 hot CPI continued in commentary: BofA and Wolfers say a 50bp December hike is back on the table, Thorne warns against it, and the 10-year touched 5% on 11-10. The bond sleeve shows that pressure only mildly at the close (BND -0.14%, IEF -0.07% today), with both sitting 1.6% above their stops. Equities rallied (SPY +1.3%, VOO +1.35%, VTI +1.3%) on US-China 'de-risk' comments, and the account gained +0.57% against the shadow's -0.21%. The 11-10 QQQ/VOO 'high/medium risk' backdrop flags look wrong at the one-day horizon again, which matches their graded pattern: right on direction over the AI-capex selloff, mostly wrong at 5 days. Per L2 I checked every held name's own earnings estimate and filings rather than relying on headline silence.

The date is the file estimate of 11-19 (last year + 364 days), with no company confirmation in the input. It is 6 trading days out today and enters the 5-day window at tomorrow's run.
